notes.title: Update - Minor bugs and issues fixed
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892990/23d2bd7c3d99f984e08c787cdba8eaadde3245a2.jpg[/img]
Hello,
A minor update to fix the following issues is now available for Get Even:
- Fixed bug: the game was crashing on start in some specific configurations
- Z keyboard button was not working on the last stage of the game

Thank you for supporting Get Even
The Farm 51 and BANDAI NAMCO Ent.
